surface_mechanism_description: The In2O3 formation mechanism during the H2O and O3 process involves two routes: (1) absorption and ion-exchange in the InEtCp step, leading to the formation of -In-O-In-OH* and subsequent oxidation to -In-O-In-O*; and (2) direct reaction of InEtCp with surface hydroxyl groups, forming -In-O-In-OH* and oxidizing to -In-O-In-O*.
evidence:
The In2O3 formation mechanism during the H2O and O3 process is proposed as follows (31):
(InEtCp step)
-In-O* + InEtCp → -In-O-In-EtCp*
-In-OH* + InEtCp → -In-O-In* + EtCpHĹ
(H2O/O3 step)
-In-O-In-EtCp* + H2O → -In-O-In-OH* + EtCpHĹ
-In-O-In* + H2O → -In-O-In-OH* + 1/2 H2Ĺ
-In-O-In* + 1/3 O3 → -In-O-In-O*
-In-O-In-OH* + 1/3 O3 → -In-O-In-O*
